# Anne Shirley & Phil Gordon

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) — friends and housemates · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Lady P60](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0060), [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Park P0](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0000), +12 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> After registering at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and feeling overwhelmed and insignificant, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) go to Old St. John's Cemetery in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport). There they meet [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), a fellow freshman who introduces herself, and the three girls quickly bond over their shared experiences and fresh beginnings.
>
> — v3 · Chapter IV April’s Lady

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P2](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0002), [v3 ch.Lady P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020), [v3 ch.Lady P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), [v3 ch.Lady P42](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0042)_

> [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) chats freely with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) about her undecided romantic life, her suitors [Alec](../character/alec.md) and [Alonzo](../character/alonzo.md), and her reasons for attending [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). Before parting, the girls inspect an old gravestone, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to lay flowers on the grave of a young sailor. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) reflect on Phil's character.
>
> — v3 · Chapter IV April’s Lady

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P48](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0048), [v3 ch.Lady P54](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0054), [v3 ch.Lady P67](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0067), [v3 ch.Lady P69](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0069)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) settle into college life at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) as the Freshmen win the annual rush led by [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) quickly takes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) into her social circle, where [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) confides her admiration for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a batch of letters from home in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), including updates from Mrs. Lynde, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), and Ruby, which reconnects her to her old life.
>
> — v3 · Chapter V Letters from Home

_Sources: [v3 ch.Home P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Home P5](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0005), [v3 ch.Home P7](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0007)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Philippa, [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and Charlie go for an autumn walk in the park and enjoy the sunset from a pavilion. On their way back along [Spofford Avenue](../codex/places.md#spofford-avenue), they admire a quaint little house called Patty's Place, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels a strong connection to.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VI In the Park

_Sources: [v3 ch.Park P14](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0014), [v3 ch.Park P24](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0024), [v3 ch.Park P30](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0030), [v3 ch.Park P34](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0034)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishes her term at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holidays. Upon her arrival, she receives a enthusiastic welcome from [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Lynde, [Dora](../character/dora.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), who builds a bonfire for her. Before bed, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) work through his guilt over wanting to use a bad word he heard from a hired boy.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VII Home Again

_Sources: [v3 ch.Again P12](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0012), [v3 ch.Again P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016), [v3 ch.Again P18](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0018), [v3 ch.Again P34](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0034)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) visit Patty's Place and convince Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md) Spofford and her niece [Maria](../character/maria.md) to rent them the home while the two ladies travel to [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe). After touring the cottage, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) return home, where [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) eagerly begs and gains permission to join their housekeeping arrangement for the upcoming school year.
>
> — v3 · Chapter X Patty’s Place

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 ch.Place P18](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0018), [v3 ch.Place P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047), [v3 ch.Place P59](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0059)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends settle into Patty's Place, furnishing the house and adopting a persistent stray cat named [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) after a failed attempt to chloroform him. [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) arrives to live with them, bringing along her two cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P14](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0014), [v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044), [v3 ch.Relationships P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051)_

> [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) explains her easygoing view on chaperoning the girls at Patty's Place. She brings her two cats, the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md) and [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), who undergo an adjustment period with the resident cat, [Rusty](../character/rusty.md). After initial turf wars and squabbles, [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) accepts the [Sarah](../character/sarah.md)-cat's dominance and eventually becomes close friends with [Joseph](../character/joseph.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Relationships P55](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0055), [v3 ch.Relationships P62](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0062), [v3 ch.Relationships P65](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0065)_

> [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) arrives with butter and chats with [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md), and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about rising prices and simple living. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) then reads aloud an entertaining letter from [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), which recounts humorously misspelled updates about his school, household misadventures, and curious questions.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVII A Letter from Davy

_Sources: [v3 ch.Davy P0](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0000), [v3 ch.Davy P5](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0005), [v3 ch.Davy P6](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0006), [v3 ch.Davy P21](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0021)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) on turning twenty and the development of her character. [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) joins them before leaving for a dance, chatting playfully about her appearance, suitors, and future marriage prospects.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XIX An Interlude

_Sources: [v3 ch.Interlude P0](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0000), [v3 ch.Interlude P3](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0003), [v3 ch.Interlude P7](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0007), [v3 ch.Interlude P24](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0024)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) chat at Patty's Place about summer plans and their housemates. [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) then finds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) alone in the orchard and confesses his love, asking her to marry him. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rejects his proposal, leaving them both devastated, and [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) later scolds [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for refusing him.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XX Gilbert Speaks

_Sources: [v3 ch.Speaks P15](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0015), [v3 ch.Speaks P31](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0031), [v3 ch.Speaks P34](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0034), [v3 ch.Speaks P48](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0048)_

> During a pleasant fortnight visiting [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits her humble birthplace where the current occupant allows her to explore the house and gives her a packet of her mother's old letters. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits her parents' grave before returning to read the letters, which make her feel truly connected to them for the first time.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXI Roses of Yesterday

_Sources: [v3 ch.Yesterday P4](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0004), [v3 ch.Yesterday P11](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0011), [v3 ch.Yesterday P15](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0015), [v3 ch.Yesterday P20](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0020)_

> [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) writes a letter to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) recounting her summer stay at a boardinghouse in [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point). She describes the quirky fellow boarders and her growing, albeit conflicted, affection for [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/jonas.md), an earnest theological student preaching there.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIV Enter Jonas

_Sources: [v3 ch.Jonas P1](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0001), [v3 ch.Jonas P3](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0003), [v3 ch.Jonas P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 ch.Jonas P23](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0023)_

> While dressing for a [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) college reception at Patty's Place, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) mentions to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) has been seeing [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md). The news secretly unsettled [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), though she left for the reception with [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md) and observed [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) with Christine across the room.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVI Enter Christine

_Sources: [v3 ch.Christine P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), [v3 ch.Christine P12](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0012), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018)_

> While preparing for April exams at Patty's Place, the girls learn they can keep the house for another year. [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) invites [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on an evening walk in the park, where she reveals that [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) has proposed to her and she accepted. They discuss Phil's future as a minister's wife, and [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) turns the conversation to Anne's feelings for [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVII Mutual Confidences

_Sources: [v3 ch.Confidences P1](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0001), [v3 ch.Confidences P10](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0010), [v3 ch.Confidences P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019), [v3 ch.Confidences P35](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0035)_

> The girls return to Patty's Place and chat with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) about Phil's engagement and Aunt Jamesina's old suitors. Later, during a rainy evening of intense studying at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) cheer themselves up by reading through dramatic stories written during their childhood [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club) days.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXV The Last Redmond Year Opens

_Sources: [v3 ch.Opens P0](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0000), [v3 ch.Opens P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010), [v3 ch.Opens P25](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0025), [v3 ch.Opens P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives news that a publisher has accepted one of her story sketches, which she happily celebrates with her housemates at Patty's Place. During a walking party with [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md), she learns that his family intends to visit her. The Gardner family arrives a day earlier than expected on Friday, leading to a frantic scramble and an awkward yet memorable call.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVI The Gardners’Call

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P21](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0021), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P23](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0023)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends reflect on what they have learned at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) as examinations end and graduation arrives. On [Convocation](../codex/places.md#convocation) day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) chooses to wear Gilbert's lilies instead of Roy's flowers, but she breaks Gilbert's necklace after hearing a rumor about his upcoming engagement. She acts blithely through the graduation dance, refusing [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) a dance, and later unwinds with her roommates and [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) at Patty's Place.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVII Full-fledged B.A.’s

_Sources: [v3 ch.B.A.’s P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P38](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0038), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P39](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0039)_

> As the girls pack to leave Patty's Place after graduation, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes for a walk with [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md). [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) proposes to her in romantic fashion, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) suddenly realizes she does not love him and refuses his proposal. She returns home shaken and confesses the rejection to [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md), who eventually forgives and comforts her.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVIII False Dawn

_Sources: [v3 ch.Dawn P12](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0012), [v3 ch.Dawn P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017), [v3 ch.Dawn P18](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0018), [v3 ch.Dawn P35](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0035)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) feeling disillusioned after rejecting [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md), but learns from [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) that he recovers quickly from heartbreak. She hears [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) gossip from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Lynde, clashes with Mrs. [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md) over Jane's lavish engagement, and attends Phil's wedding in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke). Back in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and her newborn baby, feeling increasingly lonely as her friends move on into new stages of life.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXIX Deals with Weddings
